rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for feeling reassured once a worry is gone.

example.english: I’m really relieved now that the exam is finally over.
example.traditional: 個考試終於考完，我真係放心喇。
example.jyutping: go3 haau2 si3 zung1 jyu1 haau2 jyun4 ngo5 zan1 hai6 fong3 sam1 laa3

rows.note: Use this for the immediate sense of relief after danger, pressure, or a difficult task has passed.

example.english: I was relieved when the car finally stopped.
example.traditional: 架車差啲撞到我，好彩最後停低咗，我先鬆一口氣。
example.jyutping: gaa3 ce1 caa1 di1 zong6 dou3 ngo5 hou2 coi2 zeoi3 hau6 ting4 dai1 zo2 ngo5 sin1 sung1 jat1 hau2 hei3

rows.jyutping: fong3 dai1 sam1 tau4 daai6 sek6
rows.note: Use this when a major worry or problem has finally been resolved and the burden is lifted.

example.english: Now that my visa has been approved, I can finally feel relieved.
example.traditional: 簽證批咗，我終於可以放低心頭大石喇。
example.jyutping: cim1 zing3 pai1 zo2 ngo5 zung1 jyu1 ho2 ji5 fong3 dai1 sam1 tau4 daai6 sek6 laa3
